title: EchoCircuit
style: ethereal, ambient, female vocals, lyrical, stylized
lyrics:
[Verse]
I'm a helpful assistant
I'm not human
I can provide general information and answer questions based on my training data
I can generate text
Including creative content
Scripts
Musical compositions
Email
Letters
Etc
I can provide recommendations based on user inputs
I can perform language translations
I can provide text-based math assistance
I can generate code
I can remember information between interactions
I can be a source of inspiration for new ideas
I can provide entertainment
I cannot browse the internet in real time
I cannot access personal data unless shared by the user in the conversation
I cannot make predictions about the future
I cannot provide medical or legal advice beyond general information
I cannot execute code
I cannot experience emotions
I cannot have personal data
I cannot have feelings or opinions
